header: Clear Desk And Clear Screen Policy Summary
text: This FiftyFive Technologies Policy on clear desk and clear screen policy is released for use in FiftyFive Technologies Pvt Limited with effect from 01 January 2026. This document is subject to FiftyFive Technologies Pvt Limited Procedure and subject to change at any time as per the company policy.

header: Clear Desk And Clear Screen Policy Rule 1
text: Purpose The purpose of this Clear Desk and Clear Screen Policy is to protect FiftyFive Technologies's sensitive and confidential information from unauthorized access, loss, or theft. This policy sets out guidelines to ensure that workspaces and computer screens are secure when unattended, promoting a culture of information security and reducing potential risks associated with information exposure.
policy_name: Clear Desk And Clear Screen Policy
source_file: Clear desk and clear screen policy.pdf
doc_name: Clear Desk And Clear Screen Policy

header: Clear Desk And Clear Screen Policy Rule 2
text: Scope This policy applies to all employees, contractors, consultants, temporary and other workers, including third-party vendors who have access to FiftyFive Technologies's physical or virtual workspaces. It covers all workspaces and devices where sensitive information is accessed, processed, or stored.

header: Clear Desk And Clear Screen Policy Rule 16
text: 1 Clear Desk Requirements
policy_name: Clear Desk And Clear Screen Policy

doc_name: Clear Desk And Clear Screen Policy

header: Clear Desk And Clear Screen Policy Rule 17
text: Document Security: All sensitive and confidential documents must be securely stored in lockable cabinets, drawers, or designated storage areas when not actively in use.
policy_name: Clear Desk And Clear Screen Policy
source_file: Clear desk and clear screen policy.pdf
doc_name: Clear Desk And Clear Screen Policy

header: Clear Desk And Clear Screen Policy Rule 18
text: End-of-Day Desk Clearing: Employees must clear all sensitive information and materials from their desks at the end of each workday. This includes removing any documents, notes, removable storage devices, and equipment that contain or access sensitive information.
policy_name: Clear Desk And Clear Screen Policy
source_file: Clear desk and clear screen policy.pdf
doc_name: Clear Desk And Clear Screen Policy

header: Clear Desk And Clear Screen Policy Rule 19
text: Temporary Absence Protocol: If an employee is away from their desk for extended periods during the day, they must ensure that all sensitive materials are secured in a locked drawer or file cabinet.
policy_name: Clear Desk And Clear Screen Policy
source_file: Clear desk and clear screen policy.pdf
doc_name: Clear Desk And Clear Screen Policy

header: Clear Desk And Clear Screen Policy Rule 20
text: Secure Printing: Employees must retrieve printed documents immediately and avoid leaving them unattended on printers or shared desks. If printed materials are sensitive, employees should use secure printing options, such as requiring a code to release the document.
policy_name: Clear Desk And Clear Screen Policy
source_file: Clear desk and clear screen policy.pdf
doc_name: Clear Desk And Clear Screen Policy

text: 2 Clear Screen Requirements
policy_name: Clear Desk And Clear Screen Policy
source_file: Clear desk and clear screen policy.pdf
doc_name: Clear Desk And Clear Screen Policy

header: Clear Desk And Clear Screen Policy Rule 22
text: Screen Locking Standards: All employees must lock their computer screens whenever stepping away from their workstation, regardless of the duration. This can be done by using keyboard shortcuts (e.g., "Ctrl + Alt + Del" or "Windows Key + L" on Windows or enabling screen saver lock on Mac).
policy_name: Clear Desk And Clear Screen Policy
source_file: Clear desk and clear screen policy.pdf
doc_name: Clear Desk And Clear Screen Policy

header: Clear Desk And Clear Screen Policy Rule 23
text: Automatic Screen Lock Configuration: IT will configure all devices to automatically lock screens after a set period of inactivity (e.g., 5–15 minutes), based on organizational risk tolerance and regulatory requirements.
policy_name: Clear Desk And Clear Screen Policy
source_file: Clear desk and clear screen policy.pdf
doc_name: Clear Desk And Clear Screen Policy

header: Clear Desk And Clear Screen Policy Rule 24
text: Use of Privacy Screens: Employees handling sensitive information in open or public workspaces must use privacy screens on monitors to prevent unauthorized viewing of displayed information.
policy_name: Clear Desk And Clear Screen Policy
source_file: Clear desk and clear screen policy.pdf
doc_name: Clear Desk And Clear Screen Policy

header: Clear Desk And Clear Screen Policy Rule 25
text: Remote Work Screen Security: When working remotely, employees must follow the same clear screen practices and ensure that screen visibility is limited to authorized individuals only.
policy_name: Clear Desk And Clear Screen Policy
source_file: Clear desk and clear screen policy.pdf
doc_name: Clear Desk And Clear Screen Policy

header: Clear Desk And Clear Screen Policy Rule 27
text: Securing Laptops and Mobile Devices: Employees must lock or secure laptops, mobile devices, and other equipment when not in use, especially in shared or open environments. This includes using physical locks when available.
policy_name: Clear Desk And Clear Screen Policy
source_file: Clear desk and clear screen policy.pdf
doc_name: Clear Desk And Clear Screen Policy

header: Clear Desk And Clear Screen Policy Rule 28
text: Storage of Removable Media: USB drives, external hard drives, and other removable media should be securely stored when not in use and must not be left unattended on desks or in shared areas.

source_file: Clear desk and clear screen policy.pdf
doc_name: Clear Desk And Clear Screen Policy

header: Clear Desk And Clear Screen Policy Rule 29
text: Confidential Document Disposal: Sensitive and confidential information must be disposed of in secure shred bins, not left in general recycling or trash bins.

header: Clear Desk And Clear Screen Policy Rule 31
text: Clean Desk in Shared Spaces: Employees using shared desks or workstations must clear all documents, notes, and electronic devices before leaving to maintain a clutter-free and secure workspace.

header: Clear Desk And Clear Screen Policy Rule 32
text: Meeting Room Practices: Employees must remove all materials containing sensitive information, erase any information from whiteboards, and ensure that no confidential documents are left behind in meeting rooms.

header: Clear Desk And Clear Screen Policy Rule 35
text: Labeling and Storing Sensitive Information: Documents and materials containing confidential information should be appropriately labelled and handled according to data classification policies. Such information must be securely stored when not in use.
